_doc: AUTHORITATIVE firm RBAC role->service matrix. THE single source of truth.
Everything derives from this file (edit ONLY here):
- render-access-block.sh renders the per-role 'Your access' block in each tenant's
CLAUDE.md from this (which services a role sees + scope).
- onboard-integrations.sh binds ms_shared keys to entitled roles' agents AND gates
per-user self-onboarding (a role may only connect a service it's entitled to).
- provision-tenant.sh assembles CLAUDE.md via render-access-block.sh, so it inherits this.
So the CLAUDE.md doc, the vault bindings, and the onboarding gate can never diverge.
key_type: ms_shared = one firm key distributed by role; per_user = each user supplies own.
ms_shared services are onboarded ONCE by an admin (onboard-integrations.sh); per_user
services are prompted per tenant in add-user.sh. Both read key_type from HERE, so
flipping a service between the two models needs NO code change.
NOTE on Composio: the API key is ms_shared (one firm platform key), but each user's
CONNECTED ACCOUNTS stay private -- Composio isolates them by user_id (= the tenant's
Telegram chat_id). Shared key != shared mailbox; never document it as a shared account.
roles.<role>: rw = full; read = read-only (must be backed by a real read-scoped key/RLS,
else the read restriction is not enforced -- see supabase/basic).
